links.evidence: Angels arranged in ranks (37:165) compared with those lined in ranks at 37:1; latter is an oath with debated referent.
Angels stand in ranks in 78:38, closely matching angelic ranks in 37:165.
Angels glorify God without weariness in 21:20, parallel to the angelic declaration that they glorify Him in 37:166.
37:167 introduces the disbelievers' reported speech; 35:42 describes an oath that they would follow a warner. Similar retrospective claims, not identical assertion.
37:168 wishes for a reminder from earlier peoples; 35:42 describes wishing for a warner and is only a thematic comparison.
37:169 claims they would be sincere servants if given earlier scripture; 35:42 claims they would be better guided if a warner came.
37:170 states they disbelieved in the reminder; 35:43 describes arrogant conduct and plotting after a warner came. Different emphases.
37:171 introduces God's prior word concerning messengers; 40:51 promises divine help to messengers. Read together with 37:172–173.
37:172 states messengers will be helped; 58:21 states God and His messengers will prevail.
37:173 promises victory to God's forces; 15:95 promises protection against mockers. Related divine protection, but different subject and scope; do not certify as a close parallel.
37:174 commands turning away for a time; 44:59 commands waiting as others wait. Compare also 37:178, a near repetition within this surah.
37:178 repeats the command to turn away for a time almost verbatim.
